name: Verner von Heidenstam
contribution: A Swedish poet, novelist and laureate of the 1916 Nobel Prize in Literature.

birthplace: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway

checks.lead: Carl Gustaf Verner von Heidenstam (6 July 1859 – 20 May 1940) was a Swedish poet, novelist and laureate of the 1916 Nobel Prize in Literature. He was a member of the Swedish Academy from 1912. His poems and prose work are filled with a great joy of life, sometimes imbued with a love of Swedish history and scenery, particularly its physical aspects.
